name: Hand of Anubis

features.name: Multiplier spots
features.description: Wins mark positions; repeat wins in marked spots create and grow multipliers.

features.name: Free spins
features.description: Multiplier spots persist through free spins.

review:
Hacksaw's darker take on an Egyptian cluster game – think of it as a much swingier cousin of Sugar Rush. Multiplier spots appear where wins land, and in the free spins they stay put.

That's the whole story of the bonus: if the multiplier spots build up in the right places, it can grow dramatically; if they don't, it's over quickly. The atmosphere is excellent. Very high volatility, 10,000x max and 96.24% RTP.
